name: Kefir
description: Milk fermented with grains into a thin, fizzy, sharply sour drink.

tcm.note: Not a classical food; placed with cultured milk.

ayurveda.note: Strongly soured, so ushna — more so than plain dahi.

unani.note: Read as a thinner, sourer dahi.

histamine.note: A live, mixed, long ferment — the mechanism that makes kefir interesting is also the one that makes histamine.

effects.note: Kefir's live bacterial and yeast cultures do the same job yogurt's do — the trial behind yogurt's lactose-digestion evidence tested kefir side by side with it, and lactose-maldigesting adults given a matched 20g-lactose portion produced about as little breath hydrogen (a marker of undigested lactose) after kefir as after yogurt, both far below milk's, with flatulence severity cut by over half. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
